title: Provide Agency Disclosure Form
notes: Must be presented before entering into contract

title: Property Transfer Lead Paint Notification
column13: Federal EPA penalties up to $11k per error

title: Schedule and Complete Title 5 Septic Inspection
column14: Must be within 2 years before OR 6 months after transfer. Allow time for repairs if failed.

title: Complete Title 5 Septic Repairs (if needed)
notes: Only if inspection fails. Repairs can take 2-6 weeks.

title: Schedule Smoke & CO Detector Inspection
required_if: property.type IN ['SFH','Multifamily'] AND property.city NOT IN ['Condo']
column13: Certificate valid 60 days. Schedule with local fire dept 2-3 weeks before closing.

title: Obtain Smoke & CO Certificate of Compliance
required_if: property.type IN ['SFH','Multifamily'] AND property.city NOT IN ['Condo']
notes: Must have certificate at closing. Allow buffer for re-inspection if needed.

title: Request Condo 6(d) Certificate from HOA
column13: Association has 10 days to respond. Must show no unpaid fees (clean certificate).

title: Resolve Any Unpaid Condo Fees (if dirty 6d)
notes: Only if 6(d) shows unpaid amounts. Must clear before closing.

title: Request Municipal Lien Certificate
notes: https://malegislature.gov/Laws/GeneralLaws/PartI/TitleIX/Chapter60/Section23 | M.G.L. c.60 §23
column12: Tax collector has 10 days to issue. Valid 150 days when recorded.

title: Order Final Water Reading
column13: Boston requires ~2 weeks processing. Day-of-closing bill not sufficient.

title: Monitor Buyer Loan Commitment Status
notes: Check with buyer's agent. Typical commitment 3-4 weeks after P&S.

title: Confirm Loan Commitment Received or Extension
notes: Mortgage contingency typically 30-45 days from P&S. Extension must be in writing.

title: Monitor Property Appraisal Progress
notes: Appraisal usually ordered within 1-2 weeks of P&S, completed 2-3 weeks after P&S.

title: Verify Appraisal Supports Sales Price
notes: Low appraisal may require renegotiation. Act quickly if issue arises.

title: Coordinate Home Inspection Access
notes: Inspection contingency typically 7-15 days from P&S.

title: Respond to Inspection Report Requests
notes: Negotiate repairs vs. credits vs. price reduction. Response usually due within days of report.

title: Confirm Buyer Obtained Homeowners Insurance
notes: Policy or binder required at closing. Insurance issues can delay closing.

title: Schedule Final Walkthrough
notes: Typically 24-48 hours before closing. Ensure property clean and in agreed condition.

title: Complete Final Walkthrough Successfully
notes: Address any last-minute issues immediately. Repairs must be complete.

title: Confirm Lender Clear to Close
notes: Final underwriting complete, all conditions satisfied. Closing Disclosure delivered to buyer.

title: Coordinate Utility Account Transfers
notes: Electric, gas, internet, etc. Final readings as of closing date.

title: Ensure Property Vacant and Broom Clean
notes: All belongings removed (unless negotiated). Property clean for buyer.

title: Prepare Keys
column13: Garage remotes, alarm codes, appliance manuals, HOA info, etc.

title: Review Closing Documents with Attorney
notes: Review HUD-1, deed, any liens to be discharged, payoff statements.
